title: Name Variant Collision Review
dataSources: Tree records (`genealogy:record`), DNA matches (`dna:match`), ancestor events (`ancestor:event`), archive documents (`archive:document`), tree nodes (`familytree:node`).
app: Genealogy and family-history research — tree platforms (Ancestry, FamilySearch), DNA match exports (23andMe, MyHeritage), and document / archive catalogues — streamed to Splunk HEC via GEDCOM and CSV exports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=familytree:node name_variant=*
| stats dc(person_id) as people by name_variant
| where people>1
| sort - people
description: Finds name variants that map to multiple people and may be driving mistaken merges or mistaken splits.
value: Name collisions are one of the fastest ways to create genealogy errors; this query surfaces the risky variants first.
implementation: Track normalized name variants in `familytree:node` and count how many people share each variant.
visualization: Table of name variants shared across multiple people.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces which similar name spellings may be causing different people to get confused with each other.
